thag15.2:1.4: delighting in the stilling of the mind:
thag15.2:2.2:
having gone beyond all dhammas,
to whom human beings pay homage,
thag15.2:2.3: the devas pay homage as well—
thag15.2:2.4: so I have heard from the Worthy One
thag15.2:3.2: gone from the forest to the clearing,
thag15.2:3.3: delighting in the renunciation of sensuality,
thag15.2:3.4: released like gold from its ore.
thag15.2:4.1: He, the nāga outshining all others,
thag15.2:5.1: I will praise the nāga to you—
thag15.2:6.2: are the nāga’s two other feet.
thag15.2:6.3:
Conviction is the great nāga’s trunk,
his hand;
thag15.2:7.1:
Mindfulness his neck; his head:
discernment,
thag15.2:7.3: Dhamma the balanced heat of his digestion;
thag15.2:8.1: He, in jhāna, delighting in assurance,
thag15.2:8.3: the nāga, when going, is concentrated,
thag15.2:8.4: when standing, the nāga is concentrated,
thag15.2:9.1: when reclining, the nāga is concentrated,
thag15.2:9.2: when sitting, the nāga is concentrated.
thag15.2:12.4:
but not smeared by the water
—fragrant, delightful—
thag15.2:13.1:
even so the awakened one,
well-born in the world,
thag15.2:13.3: but is not smeared by the world,
thag15.2:13.4: like the lotus, by the water.
thag15.2:15.1:
Conveying an instructive meaning,
this image is taught by the observant.
thag15.2:15.4: the nāga as taught by the nāga
thag15.2:16.1:
as free from passion,
free from aversion,
